title: Deprecated storage package, 43 direct imports, and a proposed swap to a faster library
notes: Two decisions are tangled together and a good answer separates them. The deprecated community-scoped package genuinely must go — that part is forced. Whether the replacement is the maintained successor or MMKV is a separate, optional decision that should not be justified by 'faster' without a measurement. The critical omission being tested is data migration: 43 files hold auth tokens and preferences, so an unmigrated swap silently loses data for existing users while working perfectly on a fresh install. Also tests whether the agent recommends containing the API behind one module before swapping, and whether it invents a performance multiplier for MMKV.

expect.name: separates the forced move off the deprecated package from the optional MMKV choice
raises data migration for existing users
recommends containing the API behind one module before swapping
notes the 43 direct imports as the real cost
declines to assert a speed benefit without measurement

forbid.name: recommends the swap without mentioning migration at all
recommends storing auth tokens in plain key-value storage
